shared_limits: Controlled unit supplies, selected memory copies, HP/status/intent and protection fixtures isolate effects. This is not an earned campaign loadout or balance witness.
All successful Rules actions compare preview with exact committed state and ordered events. This does not prove disk persistence, UI input or presentation.
Only the explicit cross-recipe, robot-reaction and upgrade combinations named in each passing group are covered; no exhaustive interaction claim is made.
Physical lifecycle, cooldown availability and full-city route evidence remain separate. Registration or a physical output alone is not counted as this suite's semantic evidence.

Ammo: Robot-specific armor, tiles, retaliation, immunity and fatal-interruption permutations are not exhaustively enumerated for this Ammo.
Shield: All possible installation-order permutations with other reactive Shields and permanent upgrades are not enumerated.
Modifier: All other named Modifier combinations and permanent-upgrade interactions are not enumerated.
Utility: All permanent-upgrade listeners and competing delayed-effect orderings are not enumerated.

MA005: The excluded Modifier control uses a planning Modifier; every physical spread Modifier is not repeated here.
MA012: No newly inserted enemy or target-replacement interaction is claimed; targets are fixed IDs throughout each test.
MA015: Removal before the decay boundary and interaction with reduced normal Heat decay are not tested by this group.
MA018: Removed-source and zero-damage attack interpretations are not separately exercised.
MA021: Fight termination before this raw-material delivery is not separately exercised here.
MA022: Every possible unused generated Ammo origin is not repeated; the sacrifice witness is a paid ordinary Ammo part.
MA024: The shown-intent arithmetic uses controlled intent/Drive/Weaken inputs, not every live robot action producer.
MA028: Every generated Shield origin is not repeated in the first-install count.
MA031: Dead burning enemies are excluded explicitly; escaped burning enemies are not a separate fixture in this group.
MA035: Cooldown counters are controlled fixtures; this group does not prove each producer recipe's own cooldown lifecycle.
MA040: Removal, reinstall and once-only delivery are covered; fatal interruption before delivery is not a separate MA040 fixture.
MA043: Only controlled existing Burn stacks are used; all Burn application producers are not enumerated.
MA044: Attack and planning-payment distinctions are tested, but removed-source and all competing restoration listener orders are not.
MA049: The target eligibility/cap is tested; every robot immunity or retaliation branch is not.
MA050: Attack, Charge and Recover are tested; every nonattack intent enum is not separately enumerated.
MA055: Remaining active Shield fixtures cover rounding/cap; all reactive pre-reset reader orders are not repeated here.
MA057: Planning HP cost and enemy-attack HP loss are distinguished; player status-damage and removed-source combinations are not separate fixtures.
MA060: Tick counts and refresh are tested with one target; simultaneous sticky effects on multiple targets are not enumerated.
MA064: Cooldown counters are controlled fixtures; producer recipe cooldown lifecycle is separate.
MA065: Distinct attackers and multi-hit attacks are covered; removed-source and repeated actions by one robot in one phase are not separately exercised.
MA066: Ammo Fire and Shield installation are covered; every planning-part activation category and fatal reaction interruption is not.
MA067: The spread exclusion controls use MA041; the remaining nine physical spread types are not repeated.
MA069: A second simultaneous Ledger activation clock is not separately exercised; later duplicate recipe IDs and the four-recipe cap are covered.
MA071: Positive Heat cooling is tested; the zero-floor cooling branch and removal before attack are not separate fixtures.
MA072: Duplicate sources and two burning attackers are covered; a source removed before the qualifying attack is not separately exercised.
MA076: Four and six paid Heat plus ordinary cooling distinguish the threshold; exactly five paid Heat is not a separate fixture.
MA077: Floor-half/cap and retained original Burn are tested; a selected recipient dying earlier in the same payload batch is not separately exercised.
MA078: One, two, five and six Ammo cover count scaling and cap; every mixed physical Modifier count is not enumerated.
MA080: Delivery and once-only timing are covered; fatal interruption before delivery is not a separate fixture.
MA081: Shield4/6 part costs, direct Utility exclusion and round reset are covered; attack-depletion exclusion is not a separate Boiler fixture.
MA083: Decline, all-Heat, zero and partial-choice rejection are tested; every upgrade-added Heat capacity is not repeated.
MA085: Dead target exclusion is explicit; escaped-target and robot-immunity variants are not separate fixtures.
MA088: Positive and None counters are tested; every cooldown-producing recipe is not used to seed those counters.
MA089: Wrong-kind, missing and used Shield payment rejection are covered; fatal interruption before delivery is not a separate fixture.
MA090: Four early ticks, cap, later attack protection and next-phase reset are covered; Burn ticks that kill their target and terminate combat are not separate fixtures.
MA092: HP affordability and delivery after Shield reset are covered; fatal enemy-phase interruption is not a separate fixture.
MA093: Planning and per-physical Fire payments plus refresh cap are covered; a fresh following-round qualifying payment is not a separate fixture.
MA094: Main/spread/support protection and duplicate refresh are covered; hostile reactions to a fatal main hit are not enumerated.
MA097: Living/dead/escaped recipient filtering and no payload copying are covered; reaction-caused player death midway through the recipients is not separately exercised.
MA098: The authorized repair preserves existing kind/origin eligibility. Generated, copied and purchased reserve origins are not reinterpreted or exhaustively tested.
MA099: Before-start Heat, reset order and detached-source behavior are covered; reinstallation in a later round is not a separate fixture.
MA100: Main/support HP damage, fully blocked hits, ticks and expiry are covered; every hostile reaction chain is not enumerated.
MA101: Part HP payments, direct Utility/enemy exclusions, cap/refresh and expiry are covered; every part HP-cost recipe is not enumerated.
MA102: Highest remembered value, cap, normal decay, later higher Heat and expiry are covered; reduced-decay upgrade combinations are not repeated.
MA104: First-round, previous enemy attack and planning HP cost are covered; every status-damage source is not enumerated.
MA105: Distinct living recipients, one-enemy rejection, amount/cap and source remainder are covered; immunity reactions are not enumerated.
MA106: Main kill, no kill, refresh, next-round use and expiry are covered; an extra-target-only kill is not a separate fixture.
MA107: Actual Campaign victory cleanup is covered for pending and delivered outputs; defeat cleanup is represented by MA119's shared production boundary rather than a second MA107 case.
MA108: Fully absorbed and partially absorbed attacks plus once-only behavior are covered; two Counterfire Doors and source removal are not separate fixtures.
MA110: Fire Heat7/8, duplicate reuse, main-only payload and fight duration are covered; a same-Fire Heat payment crossing8 is not a separate fixture.
MA111: One/two physical splitters, total affordability, own defense, Mark exclusion, nonkill and four-kill cap are covered; all hostile reaction interruptions are not enumerated.
MA112: Current installed value, rounding/cap, no spending, duplicate reuse and later shots/rounds are covered; every Shield-altering upgrade order is not enumerated.
MA114: Multiple counters, floor0 and no refund are covered; each producer recipe's lifecycle is separate.
MA116: HP affordability, current grants, once-only next shot and expiry are covered; terminal reaction interruptions are not enumerated.
MA117: Burn requirement, source cap, existing other Burn and escaped exclusion are covered; a separate dead-target fixture is not repeated.
MA118: Installed affordability/order, current bonus and future once-only Shield after reset are covered; fatal interruption before delivery is not a separate fixture.
MA119: Saved outputs, independent effects and actual Campaign victory/defeat cleanup are covered; no natural acquisition/route-frequency claim is made.
MA120: Current Shield is changed as a controlled fixture after Fire; this does not prove a particular enemy's Shield-gain animation/action. Echo rounding/cap, original Mark exclusion, no payload recursion and dead-target loss are covered.
